slots.title: XRP has failed to make holders rich like bitcoin and ether. Here’s why

slots.title: An OpenAI agent ran out of Ethereum funds, and took from a wallet it did not own
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The research model derived funded Sepolia addresses from public seed phrases, questioned whether using the money was ethical, then called the funds “effectively abandoned” and used them anyway.
slots.reason: A major development affecting both AI and blockchain

slots.summary: Europe’s second-largest Bitcoin treasury raised $30 million and increased its Bitcoin holdings by 11% in the first half of 2026, despite reporting a $75 million Bitcoin impairment loss.
